subject.title: Add auth sync command or auto-sync for API key rotation across agents

question: Should OpenClaw solve env-backed API-key rotation shadowing with an operator-controlled repair/warning path, automatic auth-store sync on config/env writes, or runtime fallback after credential failure?
rationale: Each viable path changes credential copying, auth precedence, or failure recovery across agent stores, so automation should not choose the permanent credential boundary.

options.title: Operator-Controlled Repair And Warning
options.body: Add doctor/status/models-auth detection plus a user-approved repair for shadowed rotated static keys, keeping credential movement explicit and auditable.

options.title: Automatic Static-Key Sync
options.body: Propagate supported static keys into affected agent auth stores automatically when config/env-backed credentials change, accepting a larger silent secret-copying blast radius.

options.title: Runtime Fallback After Failure
options.body: Try env/config credentials after a stored profile fails, accepting a more surprising runtime precedence model.

recommendation.title: Operator-Controlled Repair And Warning
recommendation.body: Add doctor/status/models-auth detection plus a user-approved repair for shadowed rotated static keys, keeping credential movement explicit and auditable.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest current history across the auth resolver, models-auth CLI, and provider-auth semantics needed for this boundary choice.
